title: Roke kehte the sarwar kya hue ali akbar
body:
Roke kehte the sarwar kya hue ali akbar
kis taraf ho aye dilbar kya hue ali akbar
Aau'n mai kidhar bolo phir pukaaro baba ko
dhoondu kis jagah jaakar kya hue ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
dasto paa me resha hai, aanko me andhera hai
ae shabeehe paighambar, kya hue ali akber
kis ne kar diya ghaayal , haaye sher ko mere
zaalimo kaho aaqar, kya hue ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ho noujawaa'n beta mai zayeefo muztar hu
aao ya ali kehkar, kya hue ali akbar
bano kehti thi rokar gham me tere ae dilbar
kya jiyegi ye maadar kya hue ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
maa khadi hai dyodi par teri muntazar akbar
kya jawaab du jaakar kya hue ali akber
